about: The session recording and Dump Capture Audio. A sequence keeps a bounded pre-roll (the last 2 s) until the first tap, whatever the setting. Whether the recording is saved is read from Dump Capture Audio when a sequence starts (launch, New Tap, Cancel, a measurement-type change, Play File — anything that starts one) and again when the setting is changed before the first tap. Turned on after the first tap, it takes effect from the next sequence; turned off, the sequence is not saved, and after the first tap the recording stops and what it held is dropped. Each case is a list of 'steps' run on a fresh analyzer at 48000 Hz with 1024-sample chunks: {"start": dump} starts a sequence with Dump Capture Audio on or off; {"chunks": n} feeds n chunks before or between taps; {"tap": true} starts a gated capture and feeds one chunk; {"dump": on} changes the setting and applies it to the analyzer; {"release": true} ends the gated capture (the tap's capture closes); {"pause": true} / {"resume": true} pause and resume detection. 'expect' is the state after the last step, each field checked only when named: 'saved' (the recording will be saved), 'recording' (chunks are being kept), 'samples' (the samples held) and 'preRoll' (the pre-roll latch is still armed — the first tap has not come). 'preRollSeconds' is the length of the pre-roll each edition keeps. Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: Dump off: the pre-roll is still kept before the first tap
the pre-roll is bounded to 2 s (96000 samples) with Dump off, as with it on
Dump off at the first tap: the recording stops and the pre-roll is dropped
Dump on from the start: 2 s of pre-roll, then the tap and everything after it
Dump turned on before the first tap: saved, and the same recording as SR4
Dump turned on after the first tap: nothing until the next sequence
SR6, then Cancel (or New Tap) starts a sequence with Dump on: it is saved from its start
Dump turned off after the first tap: the recording stops and is dropped
Dump turned off before the first tap: not saved, but the pre-roll is still kept
off and on again before the first tap: saved, with the whole pre-roll
Dump turned on while paused before the first tap: saved; the paused chunks are not kept
idle before the first tap stays bounded to the pre-roll, however long, and the latch stays armed
the first tap freezes the pre-roll latch
after the first tap the recording is completely live: no chunk is trimmed across later taps and long gaps between them
